summary: Frontend-only preview testing of the Jarvis CEO semi-interactive HUD. All 13 requested features validated end-to-end: boot -> activation -> HUD transitions, all HUD panels/data-testid elements present, reactor orb toggles state, chat command triggers simulated response, mic/parar-fala buttons work, second-brain SVG graph renders 9 nodes, node click opens editor modal, save edits the graph, add-new via '+' creates node, reset restores defaults. No console errors, no page errors, no runtime issues. Toaster is bottom-right and does not overlay API key panel.

issues: At default desktop viewport the brain legend row and 'contexto injetado' pill are pushed slightly below the graph shell and can require scroll on shorter viewports; consider tightening brain-panel vertical spacing so the legend always sits inside the visible fold.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is ~984 lines with three sub-components (ReactorOrb, SecondBrainGraph, NoteDialog) plus main App. Consider splitting into /components/ReactorOrb.jsx, /components/SecondBrainGraph.jsx, /components/NoteDialog.jsx and /constants.js for CONFIG/AREA/DEFAULT_NOTES to stay under the 700-line guideline before this preview grows.
generateRelations uses O(n^2) pair generation with a modulo heuristic; fine at 9 nodes but should be capped or memoized differently once notes grow beyond ~40.
loadStoredNotes silently falls back to DEFAULT_NOTES on any parse error but does not surface a toast, so a corrupted localStorage would look like a reset without user awareness.
seed_data_creation: none - preview uses in-memory + localStorage defaults
context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration is a preview-only build with no Claude/STT/TTS. All AI-like reactions (orb states, assistant responses) are locally simulated. All interactive elements already have data-testid. When the real Claude integration is added, ai-testing-core + ai-testing-llm skills should be loaded and the API key panel + send flow re-tested against real responses.
